caseStudies.title: Case Studies
caseStudies.subtitle: Real business impact delivered through RapidScan’s WhatsApp, Email, and Portal workflows.

items.headline: Faster Invoice Entry in the First Week
items.description: The finance team started sending invoices over WhatsApp on day one. RapidScan automatically captured Supplier, Amount, and Due Date, and synced them to their accounting system — cutting manual entry time by 95% in just the first week.

items.headline: Fewer Accounts Payable Exceptions
items.description: Using RapidScan’s email ingestion, attachments are auto-detected, totals and line items validated, and mismatches flagged before reaching ERP. This proactive validation reduced AP exceptions by 60% within the first month.

items.headline: From Upload to Structured Data Instantly
items.description: Field teams simply drag-and-drop PDFs or photos into the RapidScan Portal. The AI extracts, validates, and structures every data point in under a minute — with zero setup, zero training, and full export flexibility.

items.q: How do I send invoices through WhatsApp?
items.a: Simply save our WhatsApp number +60 10-836 6750 and send your invoice as a PDF or clear photo. RapidScan instantly extracts key details — Supplier, Date, Invoice Number, Total, and Due Date — and replies with a confirmation or direct access link to your Portal data.

items.q: Can I process invoices automatically via email?
items.a: Yes. Once your company is registered, you’ll receive a dedicated RapidScan address (e.g., docs@rapidscan.ai) to forward invoices. The system detects attachments, downloads them, validates totals and line items, and can push structured results directly to your ERP via webhooks.

items.q: Can I manually upload documents to RapidScan?
items.a: Yes, you can log into the RapidScan Portal and upload invoices, POs, or delivery notes directly from your device. Simply drag and drop your files, and our AI will extract and structure the data within seconds — no manual entry required.
RapidScan supports PDF, PNG, and JPG formats. You can upload single or multi-page files. Mobile photos are perfectly acceptable as long as the text is clearly readable.

items.q: Does RapidScan integrate with my ERP system?
items.a: Yes. RapidScan integrates with popular ERPs such as Tally, Odoo, SAP, NetSuite, Zoho Books, QuickBooks, Xero and others. We also support custom webhook integrations for bespoke ERP and accounting systems.

items.q: How secure is my data with RapidScan?
items.a: Data security is a top priority. All files and extracted data are encrypted in transit and at rest, and access is restricted to authorized workspaces. Full audit logs and optional regional data storage ensure compliance with enterprise security standards.

items.q: How fast can we go live with RapidScan?
items.a: You can start instantly — no setup required. Simply sign up and begin sending invoices via WhatsApp (+60 10-836 6750), Email (docs@rapidscan.ai), or directly through the RapidScan Portal. For ERP and webhook integrations, setup typically takes 1–3 business days depending on your workflow.

RapidScan offers flexible pricing based on document volume and feature usage. You can start with a free trial for WhatsApp or Portal uploads. For enterprise pricing or ERP integrations, contact us at bot@rapidscan.ai for a custom plan.
